source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware by Redfish when system is booted
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware through redfish
1. Check GPU can be detected correct after load GPU driver
2. Upload firmware file to SUT BMC
Command : sshpass -p 0penBmc scp nvfw_HGX-H100x8_0002_240312.1.0_prod-signed.fwpkg root@10.36.50.10:/var/tmp
3. Using POST command to start the flash progress
Command : curl ${bmc}/redfish/v1/UpdateService -T nvfw_HGX-H100x8_0002_240312.1.0_prod-signed.fwpkg -X POST (Noted : bmc=HMC ip)
4. Check firmware flash progress
Command : curl -k -H "X-Auth-Token: $token" -X GET http://192.168.31.1/redfish/v1/TaskService/Tasks/0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Exercise both GPUBB firmware upgrade and downgrade through a Redfish-managed control path while the host is booted, then prove the intended GPUBB version and GPU/host health for each direction.
original_method: The preserved source detects GPUs, stages a named HGX-H100x8 image by SCP to one fixed SUT-BMC address, POSTs to a variable described as HMC, and polls fixed Task 0 over HTTP at a third address.
manual_activity: A platform engineer binds the real BMC/HMC controller topology, approves the two version transitions, confirms the booted-host service window and recovery path, and owns the final verdict; the API task and evidence collection are otherwise automatable.
required_inputs: current, upgrade and downgrade image versions with hashes/signatures
project-approved Redfish or vendor update endpoint and payload
booted-host GPU workload state, acceptance checks and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Do not execute the literal plaintext password, root SCP, fixed IPs, HTTP task URI or curl -k source commands.
Do not assume Task 0 belongs to this request; follow only the synchronous result or response-provided task reference.
Do not transfer the named H100x8 image until GPUBB/GPU compatibility and both version directions are approved.
Capture first failure and all controller/GPU evidence; never retry, reverse direction, reset or power-cycle outside the approved plan.
agent_execution_scope: After Project SPEC binds the control plane, submit exactly one approved transition through the advertised vendor path and monitor its correlated task.
Collect GPUBB inventory plus GPU enumeration, driver/diagnostic, XID/kernel, BMC/SEL and host-boot evidence before the engineer considers that direction complete.
Repeat the opposite direction only when it is already part of the unchanged approved plan; do not assign PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the upgrade/downgrade matrix, authoritative controller, booted-state impact, activation and recovery.
Evaluate each direction separately and decide the final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its generic UpdateService sequence is only a candidate; it cannot silently replace the source's unexplained SCP-to-BMC, POST-to-HMC and third-endpoint task flow or add a reset criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the project-approved GPUBB update tool/API exposed by the authoritative controller, with protected credentials, trusted TLS and response-correlated monitoring; no literal endpoint is recommended until Project SPEC binds it.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The named package, all three endpoint references, booted state, GPU precheck and 10/30-minute fields remain preserved Master evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Discover the approved component update action on the authoritative controller, bind a signed image to the exact GPUBB/GPU platform, monitor the returned task, then verify active GPUBB inventory and independent GPU/host health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the identified GPUBB/HGX platform supported by its BMC or HMC firmware.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record GPUBB board/image, GPU SKU/VBIOS/driver, controller firmware and API schema versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-approved GPUBB/HGX update and recovery specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces embedded secret, fixed routing and guessed Task 0 with project-bound secure routing and transaction correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An alternative vendor tool may satisfy the approved project GPUBB update objective, but any unexecuted source Redfish path remains explicitly unverified.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Controller topology, signed version matrix, task/activation contract and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful HTTP response is not activation, and controller confusion can update or observe the wrong system.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may replace the source tool, package and addresses only with engineer approval and an explicit equivalence/coverage statement. It must record the original and actual method and cannot claim the source Redfish path passed when a different tool was used.
expected_evidence: Approved control-plane diagram and booted-host decision
GPUBB/GPU identity and signed upgrade/downgrade matrix
redacted submission response and correlated task transcript for each direction
pre/post active GPUBB inventory and GPU topology/driver/diagnostic/XID evidence
host/BMC/SEL health, activation timeline and recovery readiness
separate engineer verdict for each direction

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master procedure stages to fixed SUT-BMC 10.36.50.10, POSTs to `${bmc}` explicitly labeled HMC, then polls fixed Task 0 at 192.168.31.1 without transaction linkage. Preserve these facts; Project SPEC must bind one authoritative route rather than silently treating them as equivalent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: GPUBB target, upgrade/downgrade intent and required update lifecycle are identifiable. The controller topology, images, endpoint, task semantics, host state and recovery are material Project Execution Readiness inputs under ED-34/ED-36, not an irreducible review blocker.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its package/user-confirmation boundary but rejects its unverified generic endpoint, powered-off substitution and unsupported reset statement.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes permanent BLOCKED to readiness-gated execution because the approved V3.1 rules allow Project SPEC to bind tool and control path while retaining the source conflict.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently reaches a different active classification from the archived draft after direct XLSX re-read and ED-33 through ED-38 application.

review_improvement: Separates GPUBB functional coverage from the source's unsafe literal transport, makes upgrade and downgrade independently evidenced, and treats controller/image values as project bindings without weakening firmware-write safety.
independent_technical_reasoning: A GPUBB update is a defined, automatable transaction once the project identifies the controlling BMC/HMC path and compatible images. The three unexplained source endpoints make the literal commands unusable, but they do not erase the test purpose or make a safe deterministic project plan impossible; therefore execution is readiness-gated rather than permanently blocked.
